## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses tied to IT service management operations, including service disruptions, SLA breaches, or issues in service delivery (e.g., monitoring, incident response, service orchestration).
page_texts.3:
[rcas/itsm-operations/README.md#examples-of-itsm-operations-rcas]

## Examples of ITSM Operations RCAs

- Downtime in customer-facing services (e.g., e-commerce checkout)
- Service orchestration failures in service-oriented architecture (SOA)
- Misconfigured service endpoints causing delays or errors
- Monitoring system failures
- Incident response process breakdowns
- Change management process failures
- Service level agreement (SLA) breaches
- Alert fatigue and notification issues
- Service discovery and registry failures
- Capacity planning and resource allocation issues
